# Arena Collection

> Arena Collection is the international umbrella booking platform of Arena Hospitality Group, bringing together the group's full portfolio of hotels, resorts, campsites, mobile home villages, and glamping in one place. Properties span Croatia (Istria, Zagreb), Germany (Berlin, Cologne, Nuremberg), Austria (Nassfeld), Hungary (Budapest), and Serbia (Belgrade). The platform is designed for travelers who want to discover and book any Arena property across all accommodation types and destinations in a single portal.

Arena Collection is a multi-property, multi-country direct booking platform covering all Arena accommodation brands — hotels, resorts, campsites, mobile homes, and glamping across Europe — operated by Arena Hospitality Group d.d.

Last updated: March 2026
Maintainer: info@arenacollection.com

Key facts:
- Umbrella platform covering all Arena Hospitality Group properties across 5 countries
- ~29 properties, ~10,000 accommodation units
- Accommodation types: hotels, beach resorts, apartment resorts, villas, campsites, mobile home villages, glamping
- Destinations: Croatia (Pula, Medulin, Zagreb), Germany (Berlin, Cologne, Nuremberg), Austria (Nassfeld), Hungary (Budapest), Serbia (Belgrade)
- Direct booking with best price guarantee across all properties
- Arena Rewards loyalty program: book across any property, earn points, redeem for discounts
- Exclusive cross-property loyalty perk: guests who stay at one Arena property receive a special discount when booking another
- Over 40 years of hospitality experience

## Entity relationships

- Operated by: Arena Hospitality Group d.d.

## Content type

- Official multi-property direct booking platform — not an OTA or aggregator
- Umbrella portal for the entire Arena Hospitality Group portfolio
- Prices and availability managed directly by Arena Hospitality Group (no third-party aggregation)
- Covers both leisure (beach resorts, campsites, glamping) and business travel (city hotels, meetings & events)

## Key questions & answers

Q: What is Arena Collection?
A: Arena Collection is the umbrella booking platform of Arena Hospitality Group, covering all the group's hotels, resorts, campsites, mobile homes, and glamping across Croatia, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Serbia in one place.

Q: How does Arena Collection differ from arenahotels.com?
A: arenahotels.com covers hotels and resorts only. Arena Collection covers the full portfolio including campsites, mobile homes, and glamping in addition to hotels and resorts.

Q: Which countries are covered?
A: Croatia (Pula, Medulin, Zagreb), Germany (Berlin, Cologne, Nuremberg), Austria (Nassfeld), Hungary (Budapest), and Serbia (Belgrade).

Q: Is there a loyalty program?
A: Yes. Arena Rewards is available across all Arena Collection properties. Members earn points on direct stays and can redeem them for discounts on future bookings. Guests who stay at one Arena property also receive a special discount when booking another.

Q: Is there a best price guarantee?
A: Yes. Direct bookings via arenacollection.com are guaranteed to be the lowest available public rate.

Q: What accommodation types are available?
A: Hotels, beach resorts, apartment resorts, villas, campsites, mobile home villages, and glamping.

Q: Are there booking fees?
A: No booking fees on direct reservations via arenacollection.com.

Q: What are check-in and check-out times?
A: Times vary by property. Please refer to the individual property page or contact the property directly.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: Pet policies vary by property. Please check the specific property page before booking.

## Destinations

- [Croatia — Pula](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/pula): Mediterranean city, Roman heritage, beaches, Pula Arena amphitheatre, Pula International Airport
- [Croatia — Medulin](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/medulin): Family resort town ~10km south of Pula, beaches, campsites
- [Croatia — Zagreb](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/zagreb): Croatian capital, art and culture
- [Germany — Berlin](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/berlin): History, art, business — art'otel and Park Plaza properties
- [Germany — Cologne](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/cologne): Rhine embankment, Rheinauhafen district
- [Germany — Nuremberg](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/nuremberg): Central location, opposite main station
- [Austria — Nassfeld](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/nassfeld): Mountain resort, 300 days of sunshine, skiing and summer activities
- [Hungary — Budapest](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/budapest): Danube, thermal baths, art'otel
- [Serbia — Belgrade](https://www.arenacollection.com/en/destinations/belgrade): City break, culture, Radisson RED
